title: 3 comments | 🏆 Inter Club Punjab Grappling No, Gi Championship 2026 Successfully Concluded The Inter Club Punjab Grappling No, Gi Championship 2026 was successfully held over two days at Akhara MMA & Fitness Studio, Lahore. The event began with the recitation of the Holy Quran, followed by the National Anthem and the introduction of distinguished guests, officials, referees, and participating teams. Athletes from VCL Gym, Akhara MMA & Fitness Studio, Team Gujrat, Shaheen MMA, UMA, UMAF, Team Warrior, and As Sufa Jhelum showcased outstanding talent, discipline, and sportsmanship throughout the championship. The event was organized by Aqeel Ahmed Jamil, President GFA, and Syed Kamran Naqvi, General Secretary Pakistan Sudo Federation. A heartfelt thank you to all athletes, coaches, referees, officials, guests, and supporters for making this championship a remarkable success. Together, we continue to grow Grappling in Pakistan. 🇵🇰 #InterClubPunjabGrappling2026 #NoGi #GrapplingPakistan #AkharaMMA #MartialArts #CombatSports #Lahore #Sportsmanship #TeamPakistan | Grappling Federation of Pakistan
description:
🏆 Inter Club Punjab Grappling No, Gi Championship 2026 Successfully Concluded

The Inter Club Punjab Grappling No, Gi Championship 2026 was successfully held over two days at Akhara MMA & Fitness Studio, Lahore.

The event began with the recitation of the Holy Quran, followed by the National Anthem and the introduction of distinguished guests, officials, referees, and participating teams.

Athletes from VCL Gym, Akhara MMA & Fitness Studio, Team Gujrat, Shaheen MMA, UMA, UMAF, Team Warrior, and As Sufa Jhelum showcased outstanding talent, discipline, and sportsmanship throughout the championship.

The event was organized by Aqeel Ahmed Jamil, President GFA, and Syed Kamran Naqvi, General Secretary Pakistan Sudo Federation.

A heartfelt thank you to all athletes, coaches, referees, officials, guests, and supporters for making this championship a remarkable success.

Together, we continue to grow Grappling in Pakistan. 🇵🇰

description:
Here's a potential Instagram post on using a pen for self-defense:

*Title:* "Empower Yourself: How to Use a Pen for Self-Defense"

*Image:* A photo of a pen with a bold, eye-catching background or a simple illustration of self-defense techniques.

*Post:*

"Your safety is in your hands - literally! A pen can be a powerful tool for self-defense. Here are some tips to help you stay safe:

*Hold correctly*: Grip the pen firmly with the tip pointing outward, like a knife.

*Target vulnerable areas*: Aim for the attacker's face, neck, or hands.

*Use as a distraction*: Poke or scratch to create space and escape.

*Defend against grabs*: Use the pen to defend against wrist or arm grabs.

*Practice makes perfect*: Take self-defense classes to build confidence.

Remember, a pen is NOT a substitute for proper self-defense training. Stay alert, stay safe!

*Hashtags:* #SelfDefense #PersonalSafety #Empowerment #SafetyTips #PenSelfDefense #StaySafe"

*Additional Tips:*

- Consider adding a disclaimer: "Please note that self-defense should only be used in situations of genuine threat or harm."
- Encourage followers to share their own self-defense tips or experiences.
- Tag relevant self-defense organizations or experts.

This post aims to educate and empower individuals, especially women, on using everyday objects like pens for self-defense.

The Independence Day Grappling Championship 2024, organized by Muhammad Abid Hussain (President) and Hafiz Rafique Saddique (General Secretary) of Grappling Association of Lahore, was a resounding success!

Held at Shaheen MMA Gym in DHA Lahore, the event witnessed intense matches between talented players, showcasing their skills and determination.

Special thanks to our officials: Jiban Khan, Syed Muhammad Shafiq, Haroon Rashid, Tayyab Hussain, and Abdul Rahman, for their tireless efforts.

We were honored to have Aqeel Ahmed, President of Grappling Federation of Pakistan, as our Chief Guest, who presented awards to the winners and encouraged the players to push their limits.

Congratulations to all the participants and winners!

*Pakistan Zindabad!*
